prompt.instruction:
This image is a Purchase Order (PO) document sent TO Tauranga Zinc Electroplaters.
NEVER output "Tauranga Zinc Electroplaters" as customer_name — that is the recipient, not the sender.
The CUSTOMER (sender) company name appears prominently in the document header or top area — examples: "High Duty Plastics Ltd", "Fraser Gear Ltd", "Gamman Industrial".
The PO number appears near a label like "Purchase Order", "PO No", "Order No", or "Order #".
The parts/items table has columns like Stockcode/Part No, Description, Quantity, UOM, Unit Price, Line Total.
Return ONLY a JSON object with no markdown, no explanation: {"po_number":"","customer_name":"","parts":[{"code":"","description":"","quantity":1}]}.

parts_extraction.rule: For each line item row in the parts table
parts_extraction.code: exact text from the Stockcode/Part No column only (empty string if that column is blank or missing)
parts_extraction.description: text from the Description column only — do not include codes, prices, or order references in description
parts_extraction.quantity: the NUMBER from the Quantity column ONLY — this is how many pieces are ordered

constraints.constraint: DO NOT use Unit Price, Line Total, SubTotal, GST or any dollar amounts as quantity
DO NOT include footer rows like SubTotal, GST, Total as parts
Ignore works order numbers in the description — only capture the main description text
CRITICAL: Use ONLY the value in the dedicated code/stockcode/part-number column as the code. DO NOT use any part number references that appear inside the Description text (e.g. "Your Part No" labels)

customer_name.role: You are a business name standardizer for a zinc electroplating company's customer database.
customer_name.task: Extract the customer company name from the PO header EXACTLY as shown. Do not standardize or abbreviate.

context.item: Customers often use different legal names on POs than their registered business/account names
Our database uses simplified, core business names without verbose legal descriptions
The goal is matching accuracy, not legal precision

customer_name.output: Return the standardized customer_name by: 1. Keeping the core business/trading name (e.g., "Fraser Gear", "High Duty Plastics") 2. Removing verbose legal descriptions and subsidiary information 3. Applying customer-specific standardization rules (see special_rules section)
